name: Foreign Study Loan Scheme (GUEEDC)
benefit:
**Loan Amount:** Up to ₹15.00 lakh **Interest Rate:** Simple interest at 4% per annum **Collateral:** **Up to ₹7.50 lakh:** Property valued at 1.5 times the loan amount **Above ₹7.50 lakh:** Property equal to the loan amount **Loan Repayment:** **Up to ₹5 lakh:** repay in 5 years after 1-year moratorium **Above ₹5 lakh**: repay in 6 years after 1-year moratorium
**Borrower can pre-pay withou
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a **citizen of India** and a **resident of Gujarat.**1. The applicant must belong to the **Unreserved category**.1. The applicant must have passed **Class 12 with 60% or more marks**.1. The applicant must be seeking admission to **MBBS, Master’s, PG Diploma, or equivalent programs abroad.**1. The applicant’s annual family income must be **₹6.00 lakh or less.**
